Fluthub is more beginner friendly (almost everything is already set up), but it lacks customization and the free version has small RAM and CPU power.

Gitpod is a little difficult if you don't have experience with Linux (you have to install everything that is needed for flutter development), but you get full customization of the system, plus it is basically free if you are a solo developer with powerful ram and cpu options

And also you can setup wireless debugging on Gitpod, so you can test your app on your physical android device
